name: vtp-voice-prompt
description: STP (also known as VTP — Voice to Prompt) — hands-free voice assistant for Claude Code and Antigravity. 100% local: on-device speech recognition (Vosk), no API key. Wake it with a phrase, dictate the prompt, send by voice. Auto-cleans filler words, optional local Ollama enhancement, per-chat lock, focus-independent injection.

commands.title: VTP: Switch Injection Target (Antigravity / Claude Code)
VTP: Show Claude Code Patch Status
VTP: Lock Claude Conversation (Pick Target Chat)

vtp.vadMode.description: (Legacy) Enable always-on voice activity detection mode. Use vtp.conversationMode instead.

enumDescriptions: Say your wake phrase to start recording (e.g. "hey antigravity").
Press the button or keybind to start recording (Push to Talk).
vtp.activationMode.description: How a new recording session is started.

enumDescriptions: Mic auto-restarts after each send so you can keep dictating immediately.
Mic goes idle after each send. Use your activation method to start the next prompt.
vtp.postSendMode.description: What happens after a prompt is sent.

vtp.wakePhrase.description: The phrase to say to start recording (when activationMode is 'wake').

vtp.contextDepth.description: Number of recent conversation messages to pass as context

vtp.enhancementModel.description: Local Ollama model tag used for prompt enhancement / heavy cleanup (e.g. 'llama3.2', 'qwen2.5:3b'). Only used if a local Ollama daemon is running on 127.0.0.1:11434. No API key; nothing leaves your machine.

vtp.inputGateDb.description: Input sensitivity, in dBFS. Audio quieter than this never reaches the speech recognizer, so background sound (game audio, music, speaker bleed into the mic) is not transcribed. Drag the marker on the input meter to set it by ear.

vtp.inputGainDb.description: Extra microphone gain in dB. Raise this if the input meter barely moves while you speak — speech should peak above -35 dBFS for reliable recognition.

vtp.voskModelUrl.description: URL of the Vosk speech model. Accepts a vosk-browser .tar.gz OR an alphacephei .zip (auto-converted on first run). Downloaded once to local storage, then used fully offline. Default is the ~130MB 'lgraph' model (accurate). For a smaller/faster download use https://ccoreilly.github.io/vosk-browser/models/vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15.tar.gz

vtp.voiceActivation.enabled.description: When true, VTP listens in the background for the wake phrase and starts recording automatically when it is detected.

vtp.voiceActivation.wakePhrase.description: The wake phrase VTP listens for when voice activation is enabled. Shorter phrases (e.g. 'hey vtp') are easier to trigger reliably.

enumDescriptions: Send prompts to Antigravity's native chat (default).
Send prompts to the Anthropic Claude Code extension chat. Requires running 'VTP: (Re-)apply Claude Code Patch' once.

vtp.claudeCodeLockedTitle.description: When set, prompts sent to Claude Code only land in the conversation tab whose label matches this string. Empty = fan to all open Claude Code chats. Use 'VTP: Lock Claude Conversation' to set this interactively.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --out vtp-voice-prompt.vsix
scripts.compile: npm run stage && webpack --mode production && tsc --noEmit
scripts.release: npm run package && vsce publish --packagePath vtp-voice-prompt.vsix && ovsx publish vtp-voice-prompt.vsix -p %OVSX_TOKEN%
